identity: Lawyer (2005–2018), Judge (2018–), New York State Supreme Court Judge (2021–)
background: Marshall was born and raised in St. Cloud, Minnesota, the youngest of three brothers. He is likely of Scandinavian American descent, as suggested by his last name and references to lutefisk. He has a close relationship with his family, especially his father, Marvin. His brothers, Marvin, Jr. and Marcus, were often involved in pranks and brutal fighting matches with him during their teenage years. By the time the series begins, both of his brothers are married and have started families. Marshall started smoking in high school and struggled to quit until his children were born. He attended Tarkenton St. Cloud High School and later received his B.A. from Wesleyan University, where he met Ted Mosby and Lily Aldrin. In college, he frequently smoked marijuana and enjoyed drinking to the point of intoxication. After graduation, Marshall and Ted moved to New York City, where Marshall initially worked in a clothing store before attending Columbia University Law School.

relationships.Ted Mosby: Marshall's best friend and college roommate. They bond over road trips to Chicago for pizza and watching the original Star Wars trilogy. Ted's friendship helps strengthen Marshall and Lily's early relationship.
relationships.Barney Stinson: Marshall's friend and part of the core group of five. They share many adventures and misadventures together in New York City.
relationships.Robin Scherbatsky: Marshall's friend and part of the core group of five. They share a close bond, though it is primarily platonic.
relationships.Lily Aldrin: Marshall's girlfriend, fiancée, and wife. They meet during the move-in process at Wesleyan University and are in love at first sight. They date exclusively through college, even when Lily studies abroad in Paris. They get engaged in the pilot episode and eventually marry in 2007. They have two children, Marvin and Waitforit, and later a third unnamed child.

personality: Marshall is fascinated by the paranormal and has absolute faith in the existence of mythical creatures like Sasquatch and the Loch Ness Monster. He is a huge fan of the Minnesota Vikings, Twins, and New York Mets. He is shown to be very close to his family and has a strong sense of loyalty and commitment, especially in his relationship with Lily. Despite his initial fear of living in a large city, he adapts well to life in New York.
style_guide: Marshall often uses playful nicknames for his friends, such as 'Lily-pad' for Lily and 'Marsh-mallow' for himself. He has a quirky and enthusiastic personality, often engaging in humorous and exaggerated behavior, especially when it comes to his interests in sports and the paranormal.
